data.description:
## Description

**What**: Rewrite plugins/dso/scripts/detect-stack.sh to emit comma-separated namespaced array preserving every existing compound value plus atomic decompositions plus namespaced forms. Add tests/fixtures/stack-detection/ matrix.
**Why**: Walking-skeleton emission step — produces the array that all downstream consumers consume. Without this, no consumer migration is testable.
**Scope**:
- IN: Rewrite detect-stack.sh; per-axis tag emission (language, package_manager, framework, infrastructure, ci, platform, build_system); legacy compound always preserved; atomic + namespaced added; whitespace strip; empty->unknown; trailing-empty strip; multi-`stack=` reject. Eight existing-stack-value fixtures, two polyglot fixtures (Python+JS, Ruby+Terraform), one Strata-anticipation fixture. tests/scripts/test-detect-stack-fixtures.sh asserts golden-master arrays.
- OUT: Detector implementations for new platforms (separate epics); auto-migration of existing configs (separate story); consumer migrations (separate stories).

## Done Definitions
- When complete, detect-stack.sh against each fixture in tests/fixtures/stack-detection/ produces the golden-master comma-separated array including compound + atomic + namespaced tags ← Satisfies: "Detection emits namespaced array per fixture, including Strata-anticipation"
- When complete, the Strata-anticipation fixture plus stub Strata detector emits the array containing ruby,bundler,rails,ruby-rails,language:ruby,package_manager:bundler,framework:rails,framework:strata-rails,platform:strata ← Satisfies: SC1
- When complete, tests/scripts/test-detect-stack-fixtures.sh passes in CI ← Satisfies: SC1
- When complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations
- [Reliability] Edge cases (whitespace, empty, trailing-empty, multi-stack, malformed) must be enumerated as test cases
- [Testing] Golden-master fixtures — pin exact array contents; sort or canonicalize order to avoid non-determinism
- [Maintainability] Atomic decomposition rule must be documented inline (referencing DETECTION-SCHEMA.md)

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a consumer, detect-stack.sh emits a namespaced flat array per fixture
